name: Wigwag
description: Wigwag flag signalling: a flag on a staff, waved left or right for dot and dash.

code.style: --rule: ( --flip: @pick(1, -1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 20%; top: 4%; width: 6%; height: 92%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 26%; top: @pick(8%, 34%); width: 52%; height: 34%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 22% 50%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 22% 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: scaleX(@var(--flip)); transform: scaleX(@var(--flip)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
